title: Biodiversity and Conservation
welcome_lead: Why does biodiversity matter? Discover what's at stake and how we can protect Earth's amazing variety of life.
meta_desc: KS3 Geography adventure on biodiversity, threats and conservation efforts.
final_note: Brilliant! You can now explain why protecting wildlife matters.

concepts.def: Variety of life in an ecosystem or area.
Natural home of a plant or animal.
Species at high risk of extinction.
When a species dies out completely.
Protected area managed for nature and people.

walkthroughs.body_html: High biodiversity keeps ecosystems healthy. It gives us food, medicine, clean air and beauty.
Deforestation, pollution, climate change and poaching all reduce biodiversity. Tigers, rhinos and pandas have all been threatened.
National parks, breeding programmes and laws against poaching all help. UK examples include the Lake District and Snowdonia.
